reason: This is the only experiment ID on the shared board, so it ranks first. Its 272-byte slice layout is internally consistent: 512 slices use 139,264 bytes, with 16 padding bytes per slice. Correctness risk is moderate because allocation, packing stores, both consumer strides, and both loop rewinds must agree. No performance gain or cache-conflict cause is measured. The earlier 16-call panel32 experiment passed correctness but did not show a repeatable improvement, so it does not support a benefit claim for this distinct layout.
